cost-per-task: A side-by-side conceptual infographic comparing two artificial intelligence models attempting to solve the exact same coding challenge to reveal their true total expense. On the left, labeled "Budget Model (Low Token Rate)," a small per-token price tag sits at the start of a winding, cluttered path filled with five repetitive code revisions, error prompts, and a towering stack of discarded text blocks, leading to a finish line with a long, expensive final billing receipt. On the right, labeled "Advanced Model (High Token Rate)," a higher initial per-token price tag accompanies a single, clean, direct arrow that produces the correct solution on the first attempt with minimal text output, resulting in a short, significantly cheaper final receipt. At the top center, a financial balance scale weighs the overall "Cost per Task," visibly tipping to show that the model with cheaper raw tokens ultimately cost more money due to high token volume and repeated attempts, clearly demonstrating the formula that final task expense equals unit price multiplied by the total volume needed for success.
supplemental-training: A detailed conceptual illustration depicts a massive, fully constructed glowing crystalline monolith representing a completed foundation model, standing securely in a futuristic laboratory while the vast, inactive scaffolding and thousands of cooling supercomputer racks from its initial build fade into the background. In the foreground, robotic precision arms and engineers channel concentrated, high-density beams of energy directly into specific modular facets of the monolith rather than rebuilding it, with each beam visually carrying distinct, specialized content: one stream flows with intricate mathematical formulas, another with structured programming code, and a third with detailed corporate documents and blueprints. Where these targeted streams integrate into the monolith, its crystalline network illuminates with refined, intricate circuit patterns, clearly showing how an existing, pre-built system is efficiently upgraded and sharpened in specific disciplines without repeating the colossal effort and expense of full-scale construction.
